From there Mega Metagross (Clear Body ignored Gardevoir's pre-Mega Intimidate) plus Incineroar controlled the endgame: priority Bullet Punch KO'd Gardevoir under enemy Tailwind and 4x SE Ice Punch finished Noivern. reflections.adjustment: Stop spending Mega Metagross's attack into obvious Protects: when Gardevoir Protects on the Mega turn (as it did turn 4), double Noivern instead — Ice Punch breaks Focus Sash and Incineroar's Lariat secures the KO, removing the Tailwind setter a turn earlier and avoiding Heat Wave chip on Metagross.
reflections.notebook: SERIES WON 2-1. Opponent tendencies: Kingambit Protects on lead turn 1; Farigiraf does NOT always Protect on lead (G3 died to double-target before Trick Room) — turn-1 double-target on it is reliable TR denial; Noivern Protects on switch-in then Tailwinds to enable Gardevoir (Focus Sash, Timid); Gardevoir delays Mega until cornered and Protects on the obvious Meteor Mash turn — pre-Mega Intimidate is its only defense, Clear Body Metagross ignores it; Arcanine-H clicks Extreme Speed for chip even into resists; Milotic: Recover when low, Scald when healthy (Competitive+Lefties, Bold, Recover PP=5). Brings: G1 Kingambit/Arcanine-H/Noivern/Farigiraf; G2 Farigiraf+Milotic lead, Kingambit, Gardevoir; G3 Farigiraf/Kingambit/Noivern/Gardevoir (Arcanine-H, Milotic NOT brought). Winning formula vs their Farigiraf/Kingambit/Gardevoir/Noivern bring: Wide Guard Aerodactyl + Incineroar pressure early, Mega Metagross + Incineroar close with Bullet Punch/Ice Punch priority under their Tailwind; Rotom-W only needed if Milotic/Arcanine-H are brought.
